description: Creates, rotates or revokes the key that lets the developer's own machine run the app's room.js: `npx @neblla/server --app <appId> --key $NEBLLA_SERVER_KEY ./server`, outbound only, no open ports. It takes effect with serverMode "own" (set with neblla_update_app_rooms or neblla_byos). Shown once; it stays in the server's environment, never in the app. create (refused if one exists) and rotate wait in the app's queue until neblla_promote "save", the old key working until then; revoke cuts at once. Also upload the same server/ files to Neblla: they run when that machine is down. create/rotate: owner only. More: neblla_get_llms tools/server_key

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

name: neblla_server_key
